specs.derived_from: Owner earnings, incremental returns, or reinvestment runway fall below the low-case bridge.
specs.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier. The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof trace locks normalized owner earnings at 26914 USD millions (FY2025 operating cash flow proxy from us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities accession 0001730168-25-000121; AVGO/research/valuation_fact_ledger.json field normalized_owner_earnings_m). If trailing-twelve-month normalized owner earnings at Q3 FY2026 (period ending 2026-08-02) resolve below that anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and the bounded per-share range should compress toward the low case (49.70 USD per share vs 93.60 base). Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2025 (measurement end 2025-08-03) resolved 24930 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm (OCF TTM 25438M minus capex TTM 508M per accession 0001730168-25-000098). Target Q3 FY2026 is not observable at registration (2026-09-01); expected 10-Q filing ~2026-09-10 per prior-year cadence (2025 Q3 10-Q filed 2025-09-10).
